newsitem.title: USA: Clinton likely pick Fed's Yellen for CEA - sources.
newsitem.headline: Clinton likely pick Fed's Yellen for CEA - sources.

text.p: Federal Reserve Governor Janet Yellen is likely to be nominated by President Clinton to chair the Council of Economic Advisers (CEA), White House officials said Thursday.
The officials said Clinton may announce Yellen's selection as early as Friday when he makes a batch of Cabinet appointments.
Yellen would replace Joseph Stiglitz, who is leaving the CEA to become World Bank chief economist. The job requires Senate confirmation.

Last week Princeton economics professor Alan Blinder, a former Federal Reserve vice chairman and CEA member, said he had turned down an offer to return as chairman of CEA, which performs econonic analysis for the president.
